fusions.name: Pilfering Spore
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore that deals 4 damage and steals health from the target: you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fool's Cap
fusions.desc: Puffs addling spores over up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, deals 10 damage to each and stuns them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrong Pocket
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Lucky Break
fusions.desc: When 8 seconds pass without a critical hit, 25% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
